refuted.evidence: finding_drivers.dart:171 `unawaited(_prepareMapVisuals());` (initState); :491-496 `RouteTimeMarker.createIcon(pickup: false, label: context.l10n.arriveBy(clockTime(DateTime.now().add(Duration(minutes: eta + tripMinutes)))),`; :499 `_destinationPin = icons[2];`
refuted.suggested_fix: Re-create the time-pin icons when the language code (or label) changes, for example keyed like Waiting's `_timePinKey`.

verdicts.reason: The described scenario cannot happen. The language changes only in Account/PersonalInfo via the language picker (`AppLanguageController.choose`, reachable only from Home's side menu: side_menu.dart, home.dart) and at bootstrap. While FindingDrivers is mounted, its PopScope blocks leaving (`canPop: _leaving`, finding_drivers.dart:808-812), and the only route it pushes is WaitingForDriver (:535). So the rider cannot 'go to Home and switch to Français while the search continues' with this State alive. Reaching Home ends or leaves the screen (RideNavigator.home), and any later Finding is a new State whose initState renders the pin in the current language. The only other path is the `HomeLocationController.onGoodFix` zone-default switch (bootstrap.dart:119-124). It applies only when the rider never chose a language and gets a GPS fix in another zone mid-search, which is too speculative to count.
verdicts.repro: Static trace: finding_drivers.dart:159-171, 473-503, 808-812, 535; l10n.dart:126-151 (LanguageRebuild only marks elements dirty); app_language_controller.dart (choose/useZone); grep of callers of choose/useZone and of AccountHome/language picker reachability. No test run.

verdicts.reason: The scenario cannot be reached in practice. The pins are made once in initState (finding_drivers.dart:171, 473-503), but the language can only change while Finding is mounted if the rider reaches the language picker. That picker opens only from Home's side menu or Account (side_menu.dart, account_home.dart, home.dart:1850). Finding sits on top of Home and blocks pop with `PopScope(canPop: _leaving)` (finding_drivers.dart:808-811); back opens the cancel confirmation. Leaving to Home ends or disposes the search, and a cold restore runs initState again after the language has loaded (bootstrap.dart:114-117). The only other trigger is `HomeLocationController.onGoodFix` -> `useZone` (bootstrap.dart:119-124), and that matters only for a rider with no saved choice whose GPS fix crosses into a zone with a different language during one search. That is too speculative to count.
verdicts.repro: Searched every caller of AppLanguageController.choose/useZone and every route to LanguagePicker. Checked Finding's PopScope and LanguageRebuild (l10n.dart:126-151). No test was run.

refuted.title: Release base-URL validator only rejects .invalid; the reserved .example/.test/localhost hosts used by every CI production artifact pass
refuted.description: releaseApiBaseUrlProblem's documented purpose is to refuse a placeholder host whose every request would fail DNS at runtime. It checks only 'invalid'/'*.invalid'. RFC 2606/6761 reserve .example, .test and .localhost the same way, and they never resolve. All production/staging CI builds, including the signed 'production release APK', use https://api.movera.example or api.staging.movera.example, and the guard waves them through.
refuted.failure_scenario: The production APK from the Android release signing workflow starts normally. Then every API call (sign-in OTP, quotes, booking) fails with a DNS error, which is exactly what the guard claims to prevent. Worked by hand.
refuted.evidence:
lib/app/config/transport_composition.dart:26-29 final host = uri.host.toLowerCase(); if (host == 'invalid' || host.endsWith('.invalid')) { return ... }
.github/workflows/android-release-signing.yml:52 --dart-define=MOVERA_API_BASE_URL=https://api.movera.example
refuted.suggested_fix: Also reject example, test, localhost, local and their subdomains, plus IP literals, for release-like flavors. Give CI a real staging host, or build with an explicit allow flag.

verdicts.reason: The guard's documented purpose (transport_composition.dart:13-17, ARCHITECTURE.md:78) is to catch the missing-define fallback https://api.demo.movera.invalid, and it does that. The .example hosts are a deliberate CI placeholder. No backend exists yet (DECISIONS.md:55, 'Until a backend exists, each app keeps its current mock'; docs/backend-readiness-gate.md:21). The CI builds, including android-release-signing.yml:49-52, check build and signing and are not uploaded or distributed. Repo tests use api.movera.example as the accepted release host on purpose (test/app/audit_fix_release_base_url_test.dart, transport_composition_test.dart:16). No real build ships with a .example host.
verdicts.repro: Read transport_composition.dart:18-31, the workflows that use movera.example (grep), android-release-signing.yml:30-70 (no upload or publish step), DECISIONS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md.

refuted.title: Release transport guard accepts FirebasePushService with no Firebase config, so staging/production builds ship push that can never register
refuted.description: TransportComposition rejects NoopPushService/UnavailablePushService as 'Mock/no-op transport' but accepts any FirebasePushService. di.dart always composes FirebasePushService for non-mock flavors, whether or not MOVERA_FIREBASE_* or the VAPID key were passed. With no config, every register() throws PushConfigurationException, which makes it equivalent to the UnavailablePushService the guard forbids. Every production build in CI except phase78/80 has no Firebase defines, including the signed APK in android-release-signing.yml. The PushPermissionGate is still enabled (enabled: !allowsMockTransport), so the rider is offered 'Get ride updates', taps Turn on, and always gets pushFailed.
refuted.failure_scenario: A production APK is built exactly as the signing workflow does. Composition passes. The rider is shown the push primer, accepts, and sees 'couldn't turn on notifications' every time, so ride updates never arrive. The release guard that exists to catch this never fires. Verified by reading the code.
refuted.evidence:
lib/app/config/transport_composition.dart:60 if (push is NoopPushService || push is UnavailablePushService) 'push',
lib/app/di.dart:121-123 push = environment.allowsMockTransport ? NoopPushService() : FirebasePushService(api: api, environment: environment);
lib/core/notifications/firebase_push_service.dart:199-208 if (!_environment.hasFirebaseConfig) { throw const PushConfigurationException(...)
.github/workflows/android-release-signing.yml:49-52 flutter build apk --release -t lib/main_production.dart --dart-define=MOVERA_FLAVOR=production --dart-define=MOVERA_API_BASE_URL=...
refuted.suggested_fix: In TransportComposition, add 'push' when push is FirebasePushService && !environment.hasFirebaseConfig (and, on web, when the VAPID key is empty).

verdicts.reason: A FirebasePushService without config fails closed and says so. It does not pretend to succeed. register() throws PushConfigurationException before any Firebase call (firebase_push_service.dart:198-208), the background handler returns early (:33), and the test 'Phase 78 release push rejects missing Firebase configuration' (test/notifications/phase78_push_transport_test.dart:120-138) pins this as the intended rejection point. The rider sees the truthful pushFailed message (push_permission_primer.dart:129). FCM/APNs are listed as remaining intentional mocks (ARCHITECTURE.md:57-64), and the Firebase-less production builds are CI-only verification builds with a placeholder backend, not shipped releases. Making the composition check stricter is a hardening idea, not a bug on a real runtime path.
verdicts.repro: Traced di.dart:121-123 and :354-357, push_permission_gate.dart, firebase_push_service.dart:198-208, transport_composition.dart:60 and the phase78 test. Not run.

refuted.title: 'We'll notify you as soon as a driver is assigned' — nothing ever notifies on reservation assignment
refuted.description: After booking, RideScheduledPage promises a notification on assignment (`resNotifyAssigned`). Assignment (`assignMockDriver` / `applyDriverAssignment`) only updates the store and calls notifyListeners. Nothing posts to NotificationsRepository, and no toast, local notification or push is produced. The only signal is the chrono badge changing colour if the rider happens to be looking at Home.
refuted.failure_scenario: The rider books tomorrow 07:15 and leaves the app or stays in another screen. The driver accepts 15 s later and then hands over to another driver. No notification or notice is shown; Notifications stays 'All caught up'.
refuted.evidence:
ride_scheduled.dart:163-164 `Text(ReservationFormat.notifyWhenAssigned,`
reservation_format.dart:92 `static String get notifyWhenAssigned => L10n.current.resNotifyAssigned;`
reservation_controller.dart:275-287 assignMockDriver only `_store.assignDriver(...)` + `notifyListeners()`
refuted.suggested_fix: Ingest an in-app notification (NotificationsRepository) or show a toast on assignment/driver change, or change the copy.

verdicts.reason: The 'notify when assigned' promise is met by server push, not by the client mock. In release builds PushCoordinator ingests incoming pushes into Notifications (push_coordinator.dart:63,74), and notification_navigation.dart:96-98,129-134 sends a ride push for a scheduled ride to UpcomingReservationPage, so reservation notifications are an expected, handled path. assignMockDriver only runs in mock flavors (reservation_controller.dart:279-283), where push is NoopPushService and FCM/APNs are listed as intentional mocks (ARCHITECTURE.md:57-64). In demo no ride event of any kind produces a notification, so this is the documented mock gap and not a false claim on the release path.
verdicts.repro: Traced reservation_controller.dart:275-287, the di.dart push composition, push_coordinator.dart ingest, notification_navigation.dart reservation routing and ARCHITECTURE.md's mocks list. Not run.

refuted.title: Editing a contact whose stored relationship is not one of the five fixed values trips the Dropdown assertion
refuted.description: _ContactEditor seeds `_relationship` from `existing.relationship` and passes it as DropdownButtonFormField.initialValue. The items are only kEmergencyContactRelationships. EmergencyContact.fromJson keeps any server string, and relationshipLabel's own doc says 'Anything else is shown as it was typed'. updateContact also sends whatever relationship it is given. A contact whose relationship is, for example, 'Sibling' or 'family' makes the dropdown assert. Debug builds show a red error screen; release builds show an empty relationship field.
refuted.failure_scenario: Reproduced with a throwaway widget test: with a mock contact whose relationship is 'Sibling', tapping it on Emergency contacts raised _AssertionError: 'package:flutter/src/material/dropdown.dart': Failed assertion: line 1852 ... 'items == null || ...'.
refuted.suggested_fix: Normalise the value (fall back to 'Other' when it is not in the list), or add the stored value as an extra item.

verdicts.reason: No real path stores an off-list relationship. SafetyStore.createContact normalises any value outside kEmergencyContactRelationships to 'Other' (lib/features/safety/data/safety_store.dart:156-158). Edits come from the same dropdown, so they can only hold a listed value (emergency_contacts_page.dart:333-347). The safety mock API (lib/core/api/safety_mock_api.dart:208-240) only echoes what the client sent, and fromJson falls back to 'Other' when the field is missing. The /api/v1/safety/contacts endpoints are not in contracts/ (no 'relationship' or 'contacts' entry in openapi.yaml or CONTRACT.md), so no documented server sends free-form values. The failing case needs a hand-injected 'Sibling' value. It would become real only if a backend contract allowed free-text relationships; that contract would settle it.
verdicts.repro: Traced every place a relationship is written: createContact (normalised), editContact via the dropdown (listed values only), mock POST and PATCH (echo only), and the local cache round-trip of toJson/fromJson. Checked contracts/ for an emergency-contacts schema and found none. Did not rerun the reporter's widget test because it seeds an impossible value.

refuted.title: Re-running the publish workflow for the same commit fails at 'git commit' (nothing to commit) after Pages is already deployed
refuted.description: The web-live step commits the build output unconditionally. Fingerprinted names come from GITHUB_SHA[:8], and the rest of the dart2js output is deterministic. A workflow_dispatch or 're-run' on the same SHA therefore produces a tree identical to web-live HEAD. `git commit` then exits 1 under bash -e, the job turns red and no push happens, even though Pages already deployed successfully.
refuted.failure_scenario: An operator re-runs 'Publish Rider Web Demo' to retry a flaky Pages deploy. The deploy succeeds, but the job fails with 'nothing to commit, working tree clean', so every re-run of a good build shows as failed. Worked by hand.
refuted.evidence:
.github/workflows/publish-web-live.yml:166-170
          cp -a /tmp/movera-web/. .
          touch .nojekyll
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Publish Movera Rider web build"
          git push origin HEAD:web-live
refuted.suggested_fix: Use `git diff --cached --quiet || git commit ...` (or `git commit --allow-empty`).

verdicts.reason: A rebuild of the same SHA does not give an identical tree. The workflow runs `flutter build web` with no --pwa-strategy, so the default is offlineFirst (/opt/flutter/packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/web/compile.dart:120-121). In that mode flutter_tools writes a random serviceWorkerVersion into flutter_bootstrap.js on every build (/opt/flutter/packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/build_system/targets/web.dart:864-869, `Random().nextInt(1 << 32).toString()`, commented 'not a content hash'). The repo has no custom web/flutter_bootstrap.js, so the generated one is used. The published flutter_bootstrap.<sha8>.js therefore changes on every re-run, `git add -A` stages a change, and `git commit` succeeds. The 'nothing to commit' failure does not happen.
verdicts.repro: Read publish-web-live.yml:36-170 (build flags, fingerprint step, commit step). Then read the installed Flutter tooling source: compile.dart default strategy and the web.dart bootstrap generation. Confirmed that web/ holds no flutter_bootstrap.js override (ls web/).

refuted.title: Foreground ride pushes never trigger a ride resync, although the feed code says ride pushes drive authoritative resync
refuted.description: NotificationsRepository.ingest skips data-only ride pushes because 'Data-only ride pushes still drive authoritative ride resync'. PushCoordinator._handleForeground (the only listener of foregroundMessages) only ingests and logs, and never calls rideRealtime.reconnectAndResync or the restore coordinator. A foreground 'driver assigned/arrived/cancelled' push therefore has no effect until the next poll or backoff tick. If polling is paused (for example after the not-found pause), the push that should wake the ride is dropped.
refuted.failure_scenario: The app is in the foreground on Finding and polling is in backoff after network errors. The server sends a data-only 'ride.driver_assigned' push, the app does nothing with it, and the rider keeps seeing 'Finding a driver' until the next successful poll.
refuted.suggested_fix: For a ride push in the foreground (payload.routedRideId != null), call AppScope.instance.rideRealtime.reconnectAndResync(rideId).

verdicts.reason: The comment at notifications_repository.dart:26-27 is imprecise, but this causes no real wrong behaviour. Ride state comes from ApiRideRealtime polling every 2 seconds (api_ride_realtime.dart:29, 74). After failures it backs off for at most 16 seconds (realtime_connection.dart:27-31), so a missed foreground hint costs at most a few seconds. The contract does not require push-driven resync: CONTRACT.md defines only the notification feed and GET /trips. In the backoff scenario the network is failing, so an immediate resync would most likely fail too. The not-found pause (_endNotFound, api_ride_realtime.dart:349) only happens when the server returns 404 for the ride, and a server would not then send a live 'driver_assigned' push for that same ride. Pushes the rider opens do resync (notification_navigation.dart:89).
verdicts.repro: Static trace of PushCoordinator._handleForeground (push_coordinator.dart:62-71), ApiRideRealtime.subscribe and _poll (poll timer, retryAt backoff), RealtimeConnection.nextBackoff, and the contract's endpoint list.

refuted.title: Scheduled pickup label can never be the 'Current location' stand-in; the reachable English label 'Pickup location' is not translated by L10n.place (separate issue)
refuted.description: A scheduled booking with an unchanged pickup is saved with the English stand-in label: scheduled_category_gate.dart:21-23 falls back to 'Current location', the session default is 'Current location' (scheduled_rides_controller.dart:6), and with `pickupAlreadyConfirmed: true` Set pickup is skipped, so ScheduledRideCheckout stores `label: _pickupAddress`. L10n.place translates that stand-in, and ride_scheduled.dart:208 uses shortPlace (L10n.place). The Upcoming reservation 'Pickup at' fact and the History reservation card print `ride.pickup.label` unmodified.
refuted.failure_scenario: Rider books for later from the current location, then switches to Svenska. Upcoming reservation reads 'Upphämtning vid: Current location' and the History card reads 'Current location → Odenplan'. Ride scheduled already shows the translated text for the same reservation.
refuted.evidence: upcoming_reservation.dart:340-342 `ReservationFact(asset: AppAssets.gps, label: context.l10n.resPickupAt, value: ride.pickup.label,)`; reservation_widgets.dart:387 `'${ride.pickup.label} → ${ride.destination.label}',`; scheduled_category_gate.dart:21-23 `final pickupLabel = session.pickup.trim().isEmpty ? 'Current location' : session.pickup.trim();`
refuted.suggested_fix: Pass place labels through L10n.place (or ReservationFormat.shortPlace) on these two screens.

verdicts.reason: The English stand-in 'Current location' is the stored pickup label. ScheduleRide's pickup controller starts with it (schedule_ride.dart:57-58), ScheduledRideSession.pickup defaults to it (scheduled_rides_controller.dart:6), and scheduled_category_gate.dart:21-23 falls back to it. SelectRide stores label: _pickupAddress (select_ride.dart:1162, set from widget.pickupAddress at 314 when pickupAlreadyConfirmed skips the pickup step). L10n.place (l10n.dart:92-96) is what translates it, and ride_scheduled.dart:207 uses it through shortPlace/shortenPlace (place_format.dart:8). The Upcoming reservation 'Pickup at' fact (upcoming_reservation.dart:339-343) and the History card (reservation_widgets.dart:387) print ride.pickup.label raw, so a Swedish-language rider sees 'Current location'.
verdicts.repro: Static trace of how the label is stored (schedule_ride -> session -> scheduled_category_gate -> SelectRide -> ScheduledRideCheckout) and of the display sites: shortenPlace calls L10n.place, while the two cited sites use the raw label.

verdicts.reason: The stored label can never be the literal 'Current location' on this path. The only caller of openScheduledCategorySelector is schedule_ride.dart:139, and that step is reached only after _confirmPickupThenCalendar (schedule_ride.dart:133-134, 174-216). That method writes spot.address into _pickupController and the session (schedule_ride.dart:201-206). ConfirmPickupSpot._confirmPosition returns confirmedPickupAddress (confirm_pickup_spot.dart:296-303), which swaps any 'Current location' label for pickupLocationFallbackLabel 'Pickup location' (pickup_address.dart:6, 18-22, 47-50). So session.pickup is never 'Current location' when the gate runs, and the fallback at scheduled_category_gate.dart:21-23 only applies when the field is empty. Editing begins at step 0 too (schedule_ride.dart:112) and also goes through the confirm step. The fallback 'Pickup location' is also English, but L10n.place does not translate it on any screen either (l10n.dart:92-96), so that is a different issue from the one reported.
verdicts.repro: Traced every way to reach the scheduled gate (grep found one caller, schedule_ride.dart:139) and the confirm-pin label cleaning in confirmedPickupAddress and isUnusablePickupLabel. Nothing else stores 'Current location' as a reservation pickup label.

verdicts.reason:
The finding assumes a reservation can be saved with the literal pickup label 'Current location'. No booking path saves it.

1. The scheduled gate has one caller, schedule_ride.dart:139. It only runs once currentStep >= 1, and the only place that sets currentStep to 1 is _confirmPickupThenCalendar (schedule_ride.dart:216). Before that, the method writes spot.address into _pickupController and the session (schedule_ride.dart:201-206).
2. spot.address comes from ConfirmPickupSpot._confirmPosition, which is the only place that builds a ConfirmPickupResult (confirm_pickup_spot.dart:296-303). It calls confirmedPickupAddress (pickup_address.dart:46-49), and isUnusablePickupLabel (pickup_address.dart:18-22) replaces 'current location', in any letter case, with 'Pickup location'.
3. On step 1 the pickup is shown read-only. Tapping it calls _editRoute, which goes back to step 0 (schedule_ride.dart:229-233, 746-750), so the rider has to confirm the pickup again. Editing a reservation also starts at step 0.
4. That means session.pickup is never 'Current location' or empty when the gate runs. The fallback at scheduled_category_gate.dart:21-23 is dead code, and SelectRide stores label: _pickupAddress (select_ride.dart:1162) holding the cleaned label.
5. The other ways a reservation gets its pickup label also clean it. Book-later from Home and Book now both go through SetPickupPage, which uses confirmedPickupAddress and needsDroppedPinLabel (set_pickup_page.dart:754-756). The History store copies the snapshot pickup address that came from those same confirm screens.

So 'Upphämtning vid: Current location' cannot appear. The label the rider can actually get is 'Pickup location', which is also English. L10n.place (l10n.dart:92-96) does not translate it, so it stays English on every screen, Ride scheduled included. That is a different defect from the one reported here.
verdicts.repro: Static trace of every way into the gate: grep finds a single openScheduledCategorySelector caller (schedule_ride.dart:139), reached only after the confirm-pin step at schedule_ride.dart:174-216. I also ran a throwaway test, test/_audit_u171_test.dart, which called confirmedPickupAddress on stand-in labels; it was deleted afterwards and git status is clean. Output: `"Current location" -> "Pickup location"`, `" current location " -> "Pickup location"`, `"" -> "Pickup location"`, `"59.3, 18.0" -> "Pickup location"`, then `00:00 +1: All tests passed!`.
verdicts.corrected_title: Scheduled pickup label can never be the 'Current location' stand-in; the reachable English label 'Pickup location' is not translated by L10n.place (separate issue)
